## `neuro.bigUint64Array.findIndex`

Instance method on `BigUint64Array.prototype`.

> Returns the index of the first element in the array where predicate is true, and -1
> otherwise.

## Signatures

```ts
findIndex(input: { bigUint64Array: <receiver>; predicate?: (value: bigint; index: number; array: BigUint64Array) => boolean; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `BigUint64Array.prototype.findIndex` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
